title: An object authored at runtime on one replica gets no autonumber and no organization stamp on its peers until they restart
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZqfEd7pcckjz3pGqn

Source: the multi-replica HA drill of cloud#4152 (PR cloud#4288), complete local run 20261110-073953 (cloud#4152 comment 6764315091), os-dev-report 6764331402. Parent: cloud#3814 (HA tier 1); inventory `docs/design/multi-replica-stateful-inventory.md`.

## What happens
`PUT /api/v1/meta/object/<name>` on replica r1, then `POST /api/v1/data/<name>` on r2: a tenant object answers 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED` (`organization_id` required); a non-tenant object answers 201 with the autonumber field null. The r2 log says "this driver did not create the table". It persists for more than 2 minutes, and r2 heals only when it restarts (probe P08: rows created after a restart are all numbered).

## Expected
A peer that learns of an object authored elsewhere (the metadata lane) prepares it as the authoring replica does: the autonumber sequence and the organization stamp hold on every replica without a restart.

Inventory row 25 (metadata lane). Evidence: probe P04 in the run. Multi-replica only (R3: the single-node path is unaffected).
